title: 停电停水等公用设施中断
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/156_停电停水等公用设施中断.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/156_停电停水等公用设施中断/src.py

points.K3: 备用发电机保关键系统
points.S3: 停水：停加热，停相关实验
points.S4: 停气先关阀，防来气泄漏
points.S5: 恶劣天气与节假日前检查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在突然变暗的实验室里，举起手电筒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory that suddenly goes dark and switches on a flashlight, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第二课：停电停水等公用设施中断。
overlay: 停电停水等公用设施中断

shots.scene: 欣欣身边飘着灯泡、水滴、火苗三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at three floating icons, a light bulb, a water drop and a small gas flame, each with a pause mark.
shots.narration: 电、水、气突然断了，你会怎么做？

shots.scene: 阿杰在通风柜前加热回流，灯一下全灭
shots.prompt_en: In a university chemistry lab, the young male student heats a flask under reflux in a fume hood, then all the lights go out.
shots.narration: 阿杰正在加热回流，突然停电了。

shots.scene: 通风柜风机声停了，阿杰愣在原地
shots.prompt_en: The fume hood fan stops, the young male student stands frozen in the dim room with his hands still on the setup.
shots.narration: 通风柜不转了，他不知道该干什么。

shots.scene: 阿杰想先去外面看看，小研拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts to walk out to look around, and the female graduate student stops him with a raised hand.
shots.narration: 小研：先别走，先把手上的事停下。

shots.scene: 小研关掉加热开关，盖好瓶口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the heating mantle and closes the flask opening with a stopper, using a flashlight.
shots.narration: 她关掉加热，盖好瓶口，再报告老周。

shots.scene: 停电图标：先停手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dark light bulb icon and a hand making a stop gesture over a lab bench. No text.
shots.narration: 停电或跳闸，先停下手上的操作。

shots.scene: 敞口样品盖好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands closing caps on open sample tubes and covering a beaker on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 把敞开的样品、试剂盖好。

shots.scene: 逐台关掉仪器开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of instruments with their power switches turned to off one by one, check marks appearing. No text.
shots.narration: 把加热器和用电设备开关关掉。

shots.scene: 来电时机器突然启动，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: power returns and an unattended stirrer and heater suddenly start by themselves with a warning flash, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不关的话，来电时设备会自己启动。

shots.scene: 电流冲击图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lightning surge arrow hitting a delicate instrument at the moment power returns. No text.
shots.narration: 来电瞬间的冲击，也会损坏仪器。

shots.scene: 小研打电话报告老周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the older man on her phone, holding a flashlight in the other hand.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，查明是否只是本室跳闸。

shots.scene: 通风柜风机停转，气流箭头消失
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume hood with a stopped fan and the inward airflow arrows fading away, vapor drifting out. No text.
shots.narration: 停电后，通风柜就不再抽风了。

shots.scene: 【实拍】通风柜风量显示与报警面板（近景）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the airflow monitor and alarm panel on the front of a laboratory fume hood with indicator lights.
shots.narration: 风量报警响了，说明排风失效。

shots.scene: 停止有害操作，盖紧容器，拉下视窗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand capping a reagent bottle inside a fume hood and pulling the sash fully down. No text.
shots.narration: 停止有害操作，盖紧容器，拉下视窗。

shots.scene: 有气味时撤出，关门报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: people leaving a lab with a faint vapor cloud inside, closing the door and calling on a phone. No text.
shots.narration: 闻到气味就撤出，关门报告。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜同样停止操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a biological safety cabinet with a stopped fan, a hand closing culture containers inside and withdrawing. No text.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜停转，也要停下。

shots.scene: 冰箱、超低温冰箱、培养箱排成一排，指示灯熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab refrigerator, an ultra-low freezer and an incubator in a row with their indicator lights off. No text.
shots.narration: 冰箱、培养箱里，是珍贵的样品。

shots.scene: 门关紧，少开门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed freezer door with a hand pushing it shut and an icon showing cold air kept inside. No text.
shots.narration: 停电时少开门，保住里面的冷气。

shots.scene: 记录停电时间和箱内温度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes down the time and the freezer temperature reading on a blank log sheet.
shots.narration: 记下停电时间和箱内温度。

shots.scene: 时间长了，样品转移到有电的冰箱或液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sample boxes moved from a dark freezer to a powered freezer in another room and to a liquid nitrogen tank. No text.
shots.narration: 停得久，按预案把样品转移。

shots.scene: 温度报警器连着手机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a temperature alarm unit on a freezer sending a signal to a mobile phone icon. No text.
shots.narration: 关键冰箱装温度报警，能远程通知。

shots.scene: 冰箱内的易燃试剂，标签图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable liquid bottle inside a refrigerator with a warning mark as the temperature rises. No text.
shots.narration: 冰箱里的易挥发试剂，也要留意。

shots.scene: 不间断电源接着精密仪器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an uninterruptible power supply box connected to a precise analytical instrument and a computer. No text.
shots.narration: 精密仪器，接上不间断电源。

shots.scene: 停电瞬间，电源马上接上，屏幕不灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the main power line cut, a battery icon taking over instantly, the instrument screen staying on. No text.
shots.narration: 突然停电，它马上顶上。

shots.scene: 【实拍】不间断电源前面板指示灯（近景）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the front panel of an uninterruptible power supply with battery and status indicator lights.
shots.narration: 认识面板，告警时及时处理。

shots.scene: 电池电量只能撑一会儿，赶紧保存关机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery bar draining, a hand saving data and shutting down the instrument in order. No text.
shots.narration: 电池只撑一会儿，趁机保存、正常关机。

shots.section_title: 备用发电机保关键系统
shots.scene: 整栋楼停电，备用发电机启动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a whole building in darkness and a backup generator starting outside with power lines to key rooms. No text.
shots.narration: 长时间停电，靠备用发电机。
overlay: 备用发电机保关键系统

shots.section_title: 备用发电机保关键系统
shots.scene: 关键系统：冰箱、通风、报警、应急照明
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons powered by the generator, a freezer, a ventilation fan, an alarm bell and an emergency light. No text.
shots.narration: 保证冰箱、通风、报警等关键系统。

shots.section_title: 备用发电机保关键系统
shots.scene: 哪些插座接备用电，事先标清
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two wall outlets, one marked with a special color for backup power, a key freezer plugged into it. No text.
shots.narration: 哪些插座有备用电，事先弄清楚。

shots.section_title: 备用发电机保关键系统
shots.scene: 老李定期试机，发电机在室外通风处
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests a backup generator outdoors in an open well-ventilated area, checking a blank log.
shots.narration: 老李定期试机；发电机不放室内。

shots.section_title: 停水：停加热，停相关实验
shots.scene: 水龙头不出水，冷凝管里没有水流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dry tap and a reflux condenser with no cooling water flowing, a red warning mark on the flask. No text.
shots.narration: 停水了，冷凝水也断了。
overlay: 停水：停加热，停相关实验

shots.section_title: 停水：停加热，停相关实验
shots.scene: 马上关加热，冷凝失效会冲料起火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off a heating mantle under a flask, vapor escaping from the top of a dry condenser crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 立即停止加热，防蒸气冲出起火。

shots.section_title: 停水：停加热，停相关实验
shots.scene: 洗眼器打不出水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eyewash station pressed open but no water coming out, a question mark beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 停水时，洗眼器和喷淋也用不了。

shots.section_title: 停水：停加热，停相关实验
shots.scene: 停下腐蚀品、毒性实验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: corrosive and toxic reagent bottles put away and a stop hand sign over the bench. No text.
shots.narration: 要用到冲洗的危险实验，先停下。

shots.section_title: 停水：停加热，停相关实验
shots.scene: 关好水龙头，防来水漫溢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand closing an open tap and an overflowing sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 关好水龙头和冷却水阀，防来水漫溢。

shots.section_title: 停气先关阀，防来气泄漏
shots.scene: 燃气灯火焰熄灭，管道气中断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas burner flame going out and a central gas supply pipe with a pause mark. No text.
shots.narration: 燃气、管道气体中断，也要应对。
overlay: 停气先关阀，防来气泄漏

shots.section_title: 停气先关阀，防来气泄漏
shots.scene: 关掉燃气阀和用气设备阀门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand closing a gas valve at the bench and the valve on a gas-using instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 先关燃气阀和设备进气阀。

shots.section_title: 停气先关阀，防来气泄漏
shots.scene: 来气时阀门开着，气体泄漏，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gas returning through an open valve with no flame, gas clouds spreading in the room, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 阀门开着，来气时会漏出来。

shots.section_title: 停气先关阀，防来气泄漏
shots.scene: 靠保护气的反应要停下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reaction flask under an inert gas line with the flow stopped, a hand pausing the reaction. No text.
shots.narration: 靠保护气、压缩空气的实验，停下。

shots.scene: 来电了，不急着开机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lights coming back on and a hand pausing before pressing an instrument power button. No text.
shots.narration: 恢复供应后，别急着全部开机。

shots.scene: 逐台检查设备和线路
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks instruments one by one with a blank checklist after the lights return.
shots.narration: 逐台检查设备，确认无误再开。

shots.scene: 检查冷却水、气路接头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand checking a cooling water hose and a gas line connection for leaks. No text.
shots.narration: 水管和气路接头，也要检查。

shots.scene: 冰箱温度恢复，评估样品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a freezer display returning to normal and a person checking sample boxes with a log sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 看冰箱温度，评估样品能否使用。

shots.scene: 通风柜风量正常后再继续
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume hood with airflow arrows restored and a green check mark, then the experiment resuming. No text.
shots.narration: 通风正常了，再继续实验。

shots.section_title: 恶劣天气与节假日前检查
shots.scene: 暴雨雷电天气预报
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a weather warning icon with heavy rain and lightning over a lab building. No text.
shots.narration: 暴雨、台风、雷电，提前做准备。
overlay: 恶劣天气与节假日前检查

shots.section_title: 恶劣天气与节假日前检查
shots.scene: 关窗、查漏水、低处物品垫高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand closing a lab window, a ceiling drip being checked, and boxes on the floor lifted onto shelves. No text.
shots.narration: 关好门窗，查漏水，低处物品垫高。

shots.section_title: 恶劣天气与节假日前检查
shots.scene: 节假日前关水电气
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student walk through the lab before a holiday, turning off taps, gas valves and switches.
shots.narration: 节假日前，关好水电气门窗。

shots.section_title: 恶劣天气与节假日前检查
shots.scene: 需连续运行的设备报备，留联系电话
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a freezer and an incubator left running with a blank contact tag, and a message sent to the security office. No text.
shots.narration: 须连续运行的设备，报备留电话。

shots.section_title: 恶劣天气与节假日前检查
shots.scene: 王老师提醒：以本校规定为准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank emergency plan folder on a desk.
shots.narration: 停电停水的处置，以本校预案为准。

shots.scene: 灯泡、水滴、火苗三个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light bulb, a water drop and a gas flame icon, each with a switch turned off and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 断电断水断气：先停手，关开关和阀门。

shots.scene: 通风柜和冰箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume hood with its sash down and a closed freezer door. No text.
shots.narration: 通风停了停操作，冰箱少开门。

shots.scene: 逐台检查清单
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with instruments being ticked one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 恢复后逐台检查，确认安全再开。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿起电话，做出拨号手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a telephone handset and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：报警与事故报告程序。
